$comment: A workflow with a human decision and an exclusive gateway. qa verifies; an operator decides; the gateway routes yes to a reviewer sign-off and no to a rework step. Compile: baton workflow compile <this> --run <key> --input 'branch to verify'. Decide with: baton tasks approve|reject <key of the approval task> --reason ...
name: Release approval
description: Verify a branch, get a human go/no-go, then either a final review (yes) or a rework note (no). Proves approval nodes, exclusive gateways, deadlines and affinity in Baton.

outputs.name: review
outputs.description: The final review, or the rework note

data.label: Verify the candidate
data.instructions: Check out the branch named in the workflow input, run the project's test command, and register a test_report with suite, passed and failed counts and the commit sha. Do not modify source files.

data.label: Operator go/no-go
data.instructions: A person decides whether the candidate may be released, based on the test report.

data.label: Final review
data.instructions: Read the test_report and the approval review. Write a short release review: verdict approve, summary of what was verified and who approved, no findings unless something is wrong.

data.label: Rework note
data.instructions: The operator rejected the candidate. Read the test_report and the operator's review (its summary holds the reason). Do not change code. Register a handoff artefact: a summary of what must change before the next candidate, concrete next steps as a list, and any caveats.
